async def act(page):
    # Wait for the Orders link in the Sales submenu to be visible and click it
    orders_link = page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("menu").filter(has=page.get_by_role("link", name="Orders")).get_by_role("link", name="Orders")

    await orders_link.click()
